Class StatusUtils

java.lang.Object
org.apache.arrow.flight.grpc.StatusUtils
public class StatusUtils extends Object
Utilities to adapt gRPC and Flight status objects.

NOT A PUBLIC CLASS, interface is not guaranteed to remain stable.
